reviews.title: Very inexpensive fans but of good acceptable quality
reviews.comment: I used them in a small form factor PC build. They are ARGB 5v 3pin and PWM. There’s no branding on either side of the fans so it has a clean look. They’re low noise but can be moderate in noise level when they ramp up in speed. They do move a good amount of air volume when they’re spinning at or above 50% speed. Hopefully they last if I keep the fan speed low.
reviews.author: Stevie

reviews.title: Great cheap colorful fans
reviews.comment: Worthwhile purchase for a build. Loud but not too loud. Work well and look nice.
reviews.author: Nicholas Tetrault

reviews.title: Vibrant and Quiet Cooling Fans
reviews.comment: The Easy Cloud 120mm RGB Fans are fantastic for keeping my PC cool while adding a splash of color. The fans are quiet even at high speeds, and the RGB lighting is vibrant and customizable. Installation was straightforward, and they fit perfectly in my case. Highly recommend for any gaming rig.
reviews.author: Backfiring Datsun

reviews.title: I like these a lot
reviews.comment: They were very easy to install and everything works great. The noise level is almost non-existent and the lighting sent up very well with everything else in my system. A good fan for a good price
reviews.author: Jay

reviews.title: Much Better Than Expected
reviews.comment: Like other reviews, I didn't expect much but I'm impressed with how quiet these are.  The ARGB works & looks like it should.  All three are spinning to my case fan curve.  Flawless performance for at least 10 hours use thus far.
reviews.author: Rando Dando
